Type mismatch
  fun v w => G.Adj v w ∧ v ≠ t ∧ w ≠ t ∨ v = t ∧ w = s ∧ G.Adj s v ∨ v = s ∧ w = t ∧ G.Adj s v
has type
  V → V → Prop
but is expected to have type
  SimpleGraph V
extracted_code:
noncomputable def VTask.replaceVertex {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (s t : V) : SimpleGraph V :=
  -- The new graph has the same vertex set
  let V' := G
  -- Adjacent vertices in the new graph are those that are adjacent in G except for the special cases
  -- t is adjacent to exactly those vertices that s was adjacent to (excluding t itself)
  -- and the edge s-t is not in the new graph
  fun v w => (G.Adj v w ∧ v ≠ t ∧ w ≠ t) ∨ (v = t ∧ w = s ∧ G.Adj s v) ∨ (v = s ∧ w = t ∧ G.Adj s v)
  -- This ensures t's neighborhood is replaced with s's neighborhood excluding s itself
  -- and s is not adjacent to t in the result
